svg.title: PrismAPM Trace Ingestion Architecture
svg.desc: OpenTelemetry Collector or Jaeger Collector sends trace payloads to Kafka. Parser service consumes Kafka and writes normalized records to TimescaleDB. UI Server reads from TimescaleDB.
svg.metadata: Product icons for OpenTelemetry, Jaeger, and TimescaleDB use provided multicolor SVG paths. Apache Kafka is adapted from Simple Icons monochrome SVG paths.

g.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif
